references.text: The priest shall examine the mark and see if there are greenish or reddish depressions in the wall - the same procedure for inspecting leprosy in a house.
The priest shall return on the seventh day and examine whether the mark has spread - part of the same inspection process for leprosy in a house.
The priest's role in declaring a house clean or unclean after inspection - contrasted with when the mark has not spread.
The same terminology regarding malignant leprosy (צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת) is used for leprosy in garments that must be burned.
The consequence of a house being declared unclean - it must be torn down, which follows directly after this inspection.
A parallel situation where the priest examines whether a rash has spread (פָּשָׂה) on the skin and declares the person unclean.
